title: 23-BCV-010 — Engineer authentication for welding procedures (R1 and superseded issue)

facts.text: R1 applies to fabricators not certified to CSA W47.1 for fabrication of equipment-mounting skids or proprietary structural components.
R1 specifies authenticated documentation submitted to the AHJ, relevant AWS D1.1 welding-procedure requirements, and a registered engineering professional ensuring the measures in Table A.
Table A assigns owner due diligence, registered engineering professional review, owner-assigned shop inspection, welder qualification checks, continuity logs and welding-procedure approval measures.
The February 2025 issue concerned outside-Canada structural steel fabrication more broadly and is explicitly marked superseded in the catalogue/PDF.
